svg.aria-label: Ashok Adhikari Version 3.7 final architectural drawing sheet with site, ground-floor and first-floor plans
svg.title: Ashok Adhikari — Final Architectural Drawings v3.7 — Sheet A37-01
svg.desc: Versioned architectural drawing generated solely from Ashok v3.7 final model and preserved v3.6 GF/FF floor graphs. Nominal plot. No structural design or engineered wastewater route represented.
svg.text: 01 v3.7 is the final architectural version; v3.6 is preserved as a previous numbered edition.
02 GF shared bathroom retained; separate exterior WC and soak pit are not shown.
03 ST = reserved sealed-septic footprint below porch. No underground pipe, discharge or structure is designed on this sheet.
